note: Masthead navigation and branding -- renders: site logo, section names, 'Sign in', 'Subscribe', 'Search', 'Sections' menu
Section slug label -- renders: fixed section name (e.g., 'Science')
Collection header -- renders: fixed section title and navigation tabs (e.g., 'Science', 'Latest', 'Popular')
Section heading -- renders: fixed section name (e.g., 'Highlights')
Band header -- renders: fixed section title and 'See all' link
Stream tab navigation -- renders: fixed tab labels (e.g., 'Latest', 'Popular')
Pagination controls -- renders: page numbers and navigation arrows
Sidebar module -- renders: fixed module titles (e.g., 'Newsletters', 'Follow Us') and platform-defined social links
Site index header -- renders: fixed label 'Site Index'
Site footer -- renders: fixed legal links, section links, and copyright text
